sanskrit_verse:
संभूयैकतमं कृत्वा राजभाव्यं हरन्ति ये |
ते तदष्टगुणं दाप्या वणिजश् च पलायिनः || BrhS_1,17.22
transliteration: sambhūyaikatamaṃ kṛtvā rājabhāvyaṃ haranti ye | te tadaṣṭaguṇaṃ dāpyā vaṇijaś ca palāyinaḥ || BrhS_1,17.22
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who, having formed a collective unity, seize what belongs to the King, and those merchants who flee—both shall be made to restore eightfold the value taken.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in the King as representative of Dharma
Causation arises through disruption of royal integrity
Capacity-based responsibility applies equally to individuals and collectives
Restoration logic demands proportional return of seized value
Consciousness alignment requires rectification of misaligned economic conduct
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor(s) form collective AND seize royal property THEN restoration amount = 8 × seized value
IF merchant flees after transaction disruption THEN same restoration multiplier applies
IF seizure occurs under unified intent THEN all actors bear joint liability
RESTORATION precedes societal reintegration; no punitive surplus allowed
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating offenses against state assets or dignitary rights, the Supreme Court must determine whether collective action was involved and apply the eightfold restitution rule accordingly. Flight by commercial entities invokes identical restorative measures. Intent and capacity remain thresholds for liability.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that seizure disrupts cosmic-economic order (Artha-Rta). Anupūrvaśaḥ shows flight or collusion as sequential manifestations of misaligned consciousness. Responsibility is proportional to capacity and role. The eightfold return aligns perpetrator's awareness with dharmic balance without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process: Seized asset or equivalent value returned eightfold to rightful authority
Assign joint responsibility assumption protocol to all collective actors
Enforce merchant reintegration via supervised trade rehabilitation
Implement consciousness recalibration through Nyaya-based reflection sessions
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds—not from man, but from Sanatana Dharma itself. Justice restores; it does not punish. Consciousness is the ultimate arbiter. Dharma prevails.
